name: Tablet Experience
author: maxt
description: Laptop/Tablet mode for detachable 2-in-1s: sensor-following rotation, virtual-keyboard gestures + top-bar show/hide toggle (tablet only), keyboard auto mode-switch, laptop-mode display reset, and a tablet window-manage popup (close / move-to-workspace / layout).

barWidget.description: Laptop/Tablet toggle + rotation + tablet window manage + virtual-keyboard show/hide
